why: The 2I/E model is a domain- and study-specific comparative model of academic self-concept formation, not a general theory of how people learn or are taught.

The 2I/E model is a longitudinal extension of the internal/external frame-of-reference theory of academic self-concept formation, adding temporal comparisons to the social and dimensional comparisons covered by open candidate A.
